items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee discusses his brother Richard extensively. The mention of 'Little Richard' occurs only when the interviewer references Gil Evans seeing a Little Richard record in the interviewer's collection. The interviewee's response ('Wow!') indicates recognition of the name but no personal conne

ctx.x: Richard. And we used to be together, We used to go to a place called 'The Spoon and Straw'. We'd go after highschool (COUGHS), excuse me. Go after highschool and have a malted milk and a sandwich, you know what the kids do. So we used to have a phonograph machine, and it was a lamp actually. The machine was a lamp and all the records were laying on the table there and they were 78s in those days. This is 1922.
And we'd pick up the records and play them. And put them on the machine and have our malted milk and sandwich and see the new records.
